response.overview: The story follows Azlan, the founder of a renowned NGO that serves as a place where people seek help when facing life's difficulties. When a family is burdened by debt or confronted with problems too shameful to share, Azlan is the trusted individual who helps find solutions. Calm, knowledgeable and respected by many, Azlan often uses religion as a guide to comfort those in distress. In the eyes of society, he is a good Muslim man, devout and always doing the right thing. However, behind this image, his married life is far more complicated. His wife, Farhah, frequently questions Azlan's time and priorities, causing those around them to view her as a wife who struggles to understand her husband. The situation becomes increasingly complex when Azlan decides to marry Aisyah, the daughter of a poor man. Azlan defends his action by arguing that the second marriage is a responsibility and decision based on moral and religious values. However, this decision is not the solution hoped for.
response.title: Bidadari Tanpa Syurga
